servinfo.title: Warning for Dual Sensor Brake Support System

item.ptxt: Failure to take the following precautions may cause a serious accident affected by malfunction of dual sensor brake support system.
Do not affix sticker including clear film or paint on windshield.
Do not drop or otherwise expose dual sensor brake support control module to large shock. The dual sensor brake support control module that has received large shock should be replaced.
When replacing windshield and windshield wiper blade, use SUZUKI genuine parts.
After removing / installing or replacing windshield, perform Dual Sensor Brake Support Control Module Aiming Adjustment:Dual Sensor Brake Support .
Do not modify suspension. Modification of the vehicle’s height or inclination may affect correct detection of a running vehicle ahead.
Use tires of the same size and brand. Do not mix tires of different wear.
Driving a vehicle which might have been exposed to impact at around vehicle front i.e. the vehicle involved in an accident, automatic brake could work suddenly and could cause a serious accident.

When driving such a vehicle, disable dual sensor brake support system by pushing the dual sensor brake support OFF switch or ESP® OFF switch for a long time to turn on dual sensor brake support OFF light beforehand.

attention3.ptxt: When vehicle is hoisted and wheels are rotated with engine running, disable dual sensor brake support system beforehand. If not, dual sensor brake support could work unexpectedly.
